title: 第33章 部队里的三不惹
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “你，你这什么态度？”“我们就这态度了，怎么着！”丁腾飞也把手里的活儿撂下，火气腾腾的站到了陆阳身旁。刘诚气的不行：“把地上大米，给我捡起来！”陆阳瞪着他：“不捡！”刘诚调门拔高：“捡起来！”丁腾飞嗓门比他更高，并自带穿甲效果：“捡你大爷！”见压不住二人，刘诚的气势立马就弱了许多，但依旧咄咄逼人：“有你们这么和老兵说话的吗，一点儿上下级观点都没有，你们班长就是这么教的！”丁腾飞骂骂咧咧的怼回去：“你个二拐，算狗屁上级，真拿自已当干部了？”陆阳冷声道：“从我们开始干活儿到现在，你一直在边上指手画脚，还像防贼一样盯梢。我们是来出公差的，不是被你当长工在这使唤的！”“再叽叽歪歪，我们就撂挑子不干了！”“你敢！？”“我有什么不敢，本来就是义务劳动！”“你，你，你这样像是干活儿的态度吗，我告你们班长去！”“你去啊？”陆阳态度十分强硬。他占理，别说是闹到班长那儿，就是闹到连长那儿他也不怕。活儿干着，苦吃着，还得被不相干的家伙呼来喝去，颐指气使。这窝囊气，谁爱受谁受！刘诚也是被怼够呛，但他针对的并不是陆阳，单纯只是为了盯着丁腾飞。这家伙可是出了名的刺头和不守规矩，之前“泄密”搞得满城风雨，今回万一没盯住出了什么岔子。或是一把火给仓库烧了，那倒霉的可就是他了。“我不跟你俩一般见识，现在抓紧把活儿干完，不然我就去找你们班长来！”“问问他，到底是怎么带的新兵，条令条例是怎么教的？”“妈的，给你脸了？”丁腾飞捋起袖子就要干他，却被陆阳拦了下来。陆阳冷冷说道：“干活儿可以，要么你走，要么我们走，你自已选！”“尊重是互相的，你像盯犯人那样盯着我们，就别怪我们不尊重你！”刘诚也是没想到，陆阳长了这么一副伶牙俐齿。他瞧见过这小子跟在指导员后头出黑板报，也听说他被团领导点名表扬的事。说不准回头下连，就被分到机关公务班去了，这样的人他肯定不想得罪。说不定以后填个表，盖个章啥的，还得麻烦人家。刘诚哼了一声：“我可以不盯着，但你们不准偷懒，抓紧时间把活干完。”“还有，橘子苹果全都得给我轻拿轻放，要是磕着碰着出现损坏，我还得找你们！”看着这家伙离开， 丁腾飞肺都快气炸了。长这么大还没受过这窝囊气。“你刚拦着我干什么，这家伙摆明的欠揍？”“你还想进禁闭室？”“......”“部队有部队的规矩，拌嘴和打架完全是两个性质。况且，只要你先动了手，有理也变得没理了。”“那这事儿就这么算了？这口气你能咽的下？”“回头告诉班长，让他帮咱主持公道吧。”“我去，你怎么跟小孩儿一样，还告状？”见陆阳用异样眼神盯着自已，丁腾飞顿时老脸一红。像是回旋镖绕了一圈，扎在自已身上。当初他就跟个小孩儿似的，跑去指导员那儿告班长的状。但陆阳却说，这是最稳妥，也是最直接的办法。这个上等兵固然不对，但毕竟是炊事班的人。如果丁腾飞先前真在人家地盘上动了手，那就等于打了炊事班的脸。新兵连还剩两个多月，陆阳不希望接下来的日子里，隔三差五的就会在饭菜里吃到沙子和小石子。【检测到新知识点：部队里的三不惹！】【知识点分析：炊事班的不惹，祸从口出，祸从口入；卫生员不惹，谁还没有个头疼感冒呢；刚上岸的潜艇兵不惹，怨气极重，俗称水猴子！】系统弹窗补充知识点很及时。陆阳也庆幸先前拦住丁腾飞。挥拳一时爽，后果很严重。他作为班副肯定得考虑更多，顾全大局，不能因小失大。丁腾飞也是终于听劝了一回，但还是有些愤愤不平。“旁人来这出公差也这样吗，还是说就咱俩被区别对待？”“应该就咱俩。”“我靠，凭啥啊？”“就凭你。”“我？”丁腾飞指着自已的鼻子，有些不可置信。陆阳也是实话实说：“你自已啥口碑，心里没点儿数吗？人家是怕你给仓库一把火点了，怕你像以前那样找茬生事。”丁腾飞立马感觉扎心了，但还是想要反驳：“那，那针对我就行了，刁难你是什么鸟意思？”陆阳像是看傻子一样看着他：“因为咱们是一个集体，一荣俱荣，一损俱损。”丁腾飞被干沉默了，几次想要开口，但都咽了回去。他好像忽然发现，以前的自已确实挺混账的。给班级，给班长，甚至给整个新兵连都添了不少麻烦。陆阳也没再多说什么，继续埋头干活，有些话点到为止就行了。没了那家伙的瞎指挥，二人干活儿的速度都快了很多。墙边的大米被他们一个个掐出线，四四方方的像是墙砖一样。就连苹果和橘子，都按照4x4x3的方式垒在塑料袋里，每袋之间间隔都保持一致。陆阳双手叉腰，看着忙碌结果，内心还挺有成就感，瞧着还真有种赏心悦目的规整感觉。“干得不错啊。”这时，炊事班长风尘仆仆的刚从外面回来。瞧见仓库里东西归置的有模有样，当即竖起大拇指，夸他俩干活要比以往那些新兵细致认真的多。随后便表示炉子上煮了银耳莲子汤，待会干完活让他们一人去盛一碗。有这好事，陆阳也没拒绝，毕竟这是他们应得的。给炊事班干活，经常会有隐藏福利，因为这里最不缺的就是吃的。......与此同时，旗台边三班新兵站成一排。他们前半截脚掌踩在旗台边，脚后跟则处于悬空状态。如果此时陆阳也在，系统一定会提示获得新知识点：半边脚掌站军姿。这是军姿基础训练的衍生版，通过减小脚掌与地面的接触面积，来增加训练难度。进阶版本还有三分之一脚掌站军姿，以及四分之一，甚至是五分之一，也就是所谓的军姿训练——芭蕾舞版本。学过物理的都知道，脚掌受力面积越小，局部所承受的力就会越大，人也就会越难受。此时孔垄等人身体抖动厉害，完全不像是站在旗台边缘站，反倒是站在悬崖峭壁上。“我快，撑不住了！”“明明，说好站个军姿，给我们放松一下就结束训练，这尼玛也太折磨人了。”“到底是谁想出来的这些训练方式，简直比受刑，还要煎熬。”“你们能有我煎熬？我这一百八十斤的大体格子，脚都特么快断了。”“现在你知道，为啥班长非得逼着你减重了吧？”孔垄实在是难受的厉害，于是用余光瞥了眼。瞧见周凯东在二班那边监督训练，于是悄悄的将脚掌往前挪了点。受力面积增加，压迫在脚面上的力得到分散，他也终于露出如释重负的表情。果然，相比之下基础版本的站军姿，实在舒服太多。“孔垄，你作死啊，回头被班长看见了，整不死你？”“没事，我就缓缓，一会儿在挪回去，反正他不在。”如果是力量训练，孔垄就是把牙齿咬碎了，都不会偷一点儿懒。因为每一份努力，都会帮助他更好的雕刻出身上的肌肉线条。但这种纯折磨人的，他是真一点儿都扛不住，尤其是先前吊杠那会儿。因为体重更重，他所承受的垂直向下的力更大，导致他到现在两条胳膊都酸胀的厉害。而陆阳体重相对更轻，所以相对也会好受一些；但他依旧佩服陆阳的毅力，甚至觉得这家伙日后必成大器。能够主动求着被折磨，且把老兵班长都给整自闭的，这尼玛绝对是个狠人！“哎，真羡慕陆阳他们，还能去食堂里打打酱油，咱们只能在这吹冷风罚站。”“不知道晚饭吃点儿啥？中午那蒜台炒肉我还真挺爱吃的，贼特么下饭，好像还有点儿，希望晚上能热一热端上来，肯定更入味了。”“我还是更喜欢吃韭黄炒鸡蛋，金黄黄油亮亮，配上馒头来这么一大口.......”“求你们了，别说了，我特么饿一下午了！”孔垄嘴里跟发大水似的，肚子抗议的像是在打将军令。块头大，饭量大，消耗也大，整个三班他是饿的最快的。先前上思想政治课的时候，他就已经肚子咕咕叫了，又搞了一下午体能，哪能听的了这些？“不行了，我真站不动了，我感觉我要低血糖了。”孔垄舔了舔发干的嘴唇，感觉脑袋昏昏沉沉的。以往，下午训练前他都会喝点蛋白粉作为营养补充。可班长明令禁止他再碰这东西，加上中午又多了个三公里，他现在是真饿的脑发昏，眼发胀，四肢越发无力，甚至连站都站稳步的样子。“孔垄，在坚持一会儿，就快结束了！”“你赶紧站直了，不然班长瞧见，咱们得跟着你一块打针！”“垄垄，站起来，垄垄你可以的！”孔垄坚持坚持，再坚持，但始终觉得时间过得太漫长。等待的过程，他甚至已经闻到食堂飘出的饭菜香味。这让本就没什么力气的他，像是回光返照似的，脸上浮现笑容。“今晚，有韭黄炒蛋......”话音刚落，他把脚往后挪了一步，准备回到原先位置上。但却不知道是因为脚软，还是踩空的缘故，身体一个踉跄竟然向后栽倒过去......
content_en: "You, what's your attitude?" "That's the attitude we have, what's wrong!" Ding Tengfei also put down his work and stood beside Lu Yang angrily.Liu Cheng was so angry: "Pick up the rice on the ground for me!" Lu Yang glared at him: "No!" Liu Cheng raised the door and said, "Pick it up!" Ding Tengfei's voice was higher than his, and it had an armor-piercing effect: "Pick it up, uncle!" Seeing that he could not suppress the two of them, Liu ChengHis momentum immediately weakened a lot, but he was still aggressive: "Do you talk to veterans like this? There is no point of view between superiors and subordinates. This is what your squad leader taught you!" Ding Tengfei cursed back: "You two-legged idiot, you are nothing."You really think you're a cadre?"Lu Yang said coldly: "From the time we started working until now, you've been telling us what to do, and you've been watching us like we're on guard against thieves. We're here on official business, not here to be bossed around by you!"Hey, let’s give up!”“You dare!?”“Why don’t I dare to do it?”“You, you, your attitude is like a job, I’ll sue your squad leader!”“You’re going to do it?”He is reasonable and is not afraid of causing trouble to the squad leader, or even to the company commander.It's hard work, hard work, and you have to be bossed around and bossed around by people who have nothing to do with you.This cowardice will be tolerated by whoever likes it!Liu Cheng was also scolded a lot, but he was not targeting Lu Yang, he was just keeping an eye on Ding Tengfei.This guy is famous for being thorny and unruly. His "leaks" caused a storm in the city before, but if he didn't catch it this time, something went wrong.Or if a fire breaks out in the warehouse, he will be the unlucky one."I'm not as knowledgeable as you two. Now hurry up and finish the work, or I'll go find your squad leader!" "Ask him, how did he recruit new recruits, and how were the rules and regulations taught?" "Damn, did I give you face?" Ding Tengfei rolled up his sleeves and was about to fuck him, but was stopped by Lu Yang.Lu Yang said coldly: "You can work, either you go or we go, it's your choice!" "Respect is mutual. If you stare at us like prisoners, don't blame us for disrespecting you!" Liu Cheng also didn't expect that Lu Yang had such a sharp tongue.He had seen this kid following the instructor and posting on the blackboard, and he had also heard that he was named and praised by the group leader.He might not be able to go back to the next company, but he would be assigned to the government service class. He definitely didn't want to offend such a person.You might have to worry about filling out a form, getting a stamp, etc. in the future.Liu Cheng snorted: "I don't have to stare, but you are not allowed to be lazy. Take the time to finish the work." "Also, I have to handle all the oranges and apples with care. If they are damaged due to collision, I have to look for you!" Watching this guy leave, Ding Tengfei's lungs almost exploded with anger.I have never experienced such cowardice in my whole life."What did you just stop me for? This guy clearly deserves a beating?" "You still want to go into the solitary room?" "..." "The army has army rules, and bickering and fighting are completely different. Besides, as long as you make a move first, what is reasonable becomes irrational.""Then let this matter go? Can you swallow this?" "Tell the squad leader later and let him help us seek justice." "I'll go, why are you acting like a child and still complaining?" Seeing Lu Yang staring at him with a strange look, Ding Tengfei suddenly blushed.It was like a boomerang going around in a circle and piercing himself.At first, he was just like a child, running to the instructor to complain to the monitor.But Lu Yang said that this was the safest and most direct way.Although this superior soldier was wrong, he was still a member of the cooking class.If Ding Tengfei had really made a move on other people's territory before, it would have been a slap in the face of the cooking class.There are still more than two months left in the recruit company, and Lu Yang doesn't want to eat sand and pebbles in his meals every now and then in the coming days.[New knowledge point detected: There are three things not to mess with in the army!】[Analysis of knowledge points: If you don’t mess with the cooking class, trouble comes from the mouth, and trouble comes from the mouth; if you don’t mess with the health workers, who doesn’t have a headache or a cold? If you don’t mess with the submarine soldiers who have just landed, they will be extremely resentful and are commonly known as water monkeys!】The system pop-up window to supplement knowledge points is very timely.Lu Yang was also thankful that he had stopped Ding Tengfei earlier.Pumping your fist feels good for a while, but the consequences are serious.As the squad vice president, he must consider more, take the overall situation into consideration, and not lose the big for the small.Ding Tengfei finally listened to the advice, but he was still a little aggrieved."Is this the case for other people who come here on business, or are we just the two treated differently?" "It should be just the two of us." "Damn, why?" "Just you." "Me?" Ding Tengfei pointed to his nose, a little in disbelief.Lu Yang also told the truth: "Don't you have some idea about your own reputation? People are afraid that you will light the fire in the warehouse and cause trouble like before." Ding Tengfei immediately felt heartbroken, but still wanted to refute: "Well, thenJust target me, what do you mean by making things difficult for you?" Lu Yang looked at him as if he were a fool: "Because we are a collective, we all prosper and suffer." Ding Tengfei was silenced. He wanted to speak several times, but he swallowed it.He seemed to suddenly realize that he was indeed quite a jerk in the past.It caused a lot of trouble for the class, the squad leader, and even the entire company of recruits.Lu Yang didn't say anything more and continued to work hard. He just wanted to stop talking.Without that guy's blind command, the two of them worked much faster.They pinched out the rice one by one, making it look as square as wall bricks.Even the apples and oranges are packed in plastic bags in a 4x4x3 pattern, with consistent spacing between each bag.Lu Yang put his hands on his hips and looked at the results of his busy work. He felt quite accomplished and felt a pleasing sense of orderliness."Good job." At this time, the cooking squad leader had just come back from outside.Seeing the orderly arrangement of things in the warehouse, I immediately gave him a thumbs up and praised them for being much more meticulous and conscientious in their work than the previous recruits.Then he said that Tremella and lotus seed soup was boiling on the stove, and he would let each of them fill a bowl after the work was done.Lu Yang did not refuse this good thing, after all, it was what they deserved.Working for the cooking team often brings hidden benefits, because the most indispensable thing here is food....At the same time, three classes of recruits stood in a row beside the flag stand.The front half of their feet are on the edge of the flag stand, while the heels are in the air.If Lu Yang is here at this time, the system will definitely prompt you to obtain new knowledge points: stand on the soles of your feet in a military posture.This is a derivative version of military posture basic training. It increases the difficulty of training by reducing the contact area between the soles of the feet and the ground.The advanced version also has one third of the foot standing in military posture, and one fourth, or even one fifth, of the so-called military posture training - the ballet version.Anyone who has studied physics knows that the smaller the force-bearing area of ​​the sole of the foot, the greater the force the local area will bear, and the more uncomfortable the person will be.At this time, the bodies of Kong Long and others were shaking violently. They did not look like they were standing on the edge of the flag platform, but on the cliff."I'm going, I can't hold it anymore!" "Obviously, they agreed to stand in a military posture and let us relax for a while before ending the training. This is too torture." "Who on earth came up with these training methods? They are simply more torturous than torture.""How can you endure this pain like me? I weigh about 180 kilograms, and my legs are about to break." "Now you know why the squad leader had to force you to lose weight, right?" Kong Long felt really uncomfortable, so he glanced at me from the corner of his eye.Seeing Zhou Kaidong supervising the training in the second class, he quietly moved his feet forward.The force-bearing area increased, and the force pressing on the foot was dispersed, and he finally showed an expression of relief.Sure enough, compared to the basic version of the military stance, it is much more comfortable."Kong Long, you are seeking death. The squad leader saw you when you turned around. Will you be killed?" "It's okay. I'll take it slow and move back later. He's not here anyway." If it was strength training, Kong Long would chew his teeth to pieces without being lazy.Because every effort will help him better sculpt the muscle lines on his body.But he really couldn't handle this kind of pure torture, especially when he was hanging on the bar.Because he weighed more, he suffered greater vertical downward force, which caused severe soreness in both of his arms.Lu Yang was relatively lighter, so he would feel better; but he still admired Lu Yang's perseverance, and even felt that this guy would become a great person in the future.He is definitely a ruthless person who can actively ask to be tortured and even make a veteran squad leader become autistic!"Hey, I really envy Lu Yang and the others. They can go to the cafeteria to make soy sauce. We can only stand here while the cold wind blows." "I wonder what we should have for dinner? I really like the fried pork with garlic at noon. There seems to be some left with the meal. I hope it can be heated up and served in the evening. I'm sureIt's more delicious." "I still prefer to eat fried eggs with leeks, golden butter, and a big mouthful with steamed buns..." "Please, stop talking, I've been so hungry all afternoon!" Kong Rong's mouth felt like it was full of water, and his stomach was protesting like a general's order.He is big, eats a lot, and consumes a lot. He gets hungry the fastest in the entire third shift.When he took the ideological and political class earlier, his stomach was already growling, and he had to do physical fitness all afternoon. How could he listen to this?"No, I can't stand anymore. I feel like I'm going to have hypoglycemia." Kong Long licked his dry lips, feeling dizzy.In the past, he would drink some protein powder as a nutritional supplement before training in the afternoon.However, the squad leader explicitly prohibited him from touching this thing again. In addition, he had traveled an extra three kilometers at noon. Now he was so hungry that his brain was dizzy, his eyes were swollen, and his limbs were getting weaker. He even seemed to be unable to stand steadily."Kong Long, hold on for a while, it's almost over!" "Hurry up and stand up straight, otherwise the squad leader will see us and we have to follow you to get the injection!" "Long Long, stand up, Long Long, you can do it!" Kong Long persisted, and persisted, but he still felt that the time passed too long.While waiting, he could even smell the aroma of food wafting from the canteen.This made him, who was already weak, seem to be having a flashback, with a smile on his face."Tonight, there will be scrambled eggs with chives..." As soon as he finished speaking, he took a step back, preparing to return to the original position.But he didn't know whether it was because his feet were weak or because he stepped on the air, but his body stumbled and fell backwards...
